title: glab mr note create cannot post an internal note
description:
The GitLab API supports internal notes on merge requests (`internal: true` on `POST /projects/:id/merge_requests/:iid/notes`), and the vendored `gitlab.com/gitlab-org/api/client-go/v3` client exposes `CreateMergeRequestNoteOptions.Internal *bool`. Neither `glab mr note create` nor its MCP tool equivalent exposes a way to set it — every note posted through the normal path is public, with no flag to change that.

This forces anyone scripting a maintainer workflow (replying to an internal security discussion, for example) to drop to `glab api` directly, which is exactly the kind of gap this CLI is meant to paper over.

## Proposed fix

Add an `--internal` boolean flag to `glab mr note create` that sets `CreateMergeRequestNoteOptions.Internal`, and expose it on the corresponding MCP tool annotation. Flag description should note that internal notes are visible only to project members.

## Found via

A glab maintainer pass that needed to post an internal reply and had to fall back to `glab api` for it. No existing issue found (searched "internal note", "internal comment mr note").
